title: Polynomial-Time Computability of a Base Test
statement: For every nondeterministic finite Turing machine $N$ and natural numbers $d,c,A,a$, the function sending a Boolean word $y$ to the one-bit word whose bit is true when either the two extracted blocks at offsets $3w^2+w$ and $3w^2+2w$ agree, or the encoded data certify a valid step of $N$, is polynomial-time computable; here $w=A(|x|+1)^a$ and $x$ is the first component extracted from $y$.
hypotheses_covered: A nondeterministic finite Turing machine $N$ over Boolean symbols
